sloka: मां हि धर्मात्मनः पत्नीं शचीमिव शचीपतेः ।त्वदन्यस्त्रिषु लोकेषु प्रार्थयेन्मनसापि कः ।। ५.२०.१४।।।।
transliteration: māṁ hi dharmātmanaḥ patnīṁ śacīmiva śacīpateḥ ।tvadanyastriṣu lokeṣu prārthayenmanasāpi kaḥ ।। 5.20.14।।।।

translations.english: "O Vaidehi you have (extraordinary) beauty and (exuberant) youth. Who would not lose his balance of mind even if he were Brahma the grandsire himself after getting you?
